metadata.title: joymagic - Create Stunning AI Images & Videos
metadata.description: joymagic is an AI-powered creative platform for image and video generation. Create high-quality visuals from text, enhance content faster, and explore powerful AI tools for modern creators.
metadata.keywords: joymagic, image generation, AI, diffusion transformer, open source, computer vision, deep learning
